repos.description: 解决Cursor在免费订阅期间出现以下提示的问题:  Your request has been blocked as our system has detected suspicious activity / You've reached your trial request limit.  /  Too many free trial accounts used on this machine.
repos.summary_zh: go-cursor-help是一款用于重置Cursor AI IDE免费试用状态的工具，专门解决因系统检测异常活动、达到试用请求限制或设备关联过多试用账号而导致的阻断问题。通过自动化机制绕过Cursor的试用验证，使开发者能够持续使用AI编程功能。该仓库同时提供付费Cursor Pro账号及7天通行证等订阅服务，形成工具+账号的完整解决方案。
repos.summary_en: go-cursor-help is a tool designed to reset the free trial status of Cursor AI IDE, specifically addressing block issues caused by suspicious activity detection, trial request limits, or excessive trial accounts on a single machine. It automates bypassing Cursor's trial verification, enabling developers to continuously access AI programming features. The repository also offers paid Cursor Pro accounts and 7-day passes, providing a complete tool-and-account solution.

repos.description: Check if an email address exists without sending any email, written in Rust. Comes with a ⚙️ HTTP backend.
repos.summary_zh: reacherhq/check-if-email-exists 是一个用 Rust 编写的开源工具，可在不发送邮件的情况下验证邮箱地址是否存在及可交付性。提供 Docker HTTP 后端（最受欢迎）、CLI 工具和 Rust 库三种方式。核心亮点包括 SMTP 连接探测、MX 记录验证、一次性邮箱与角色账号检测、catch-all 判断等，输出详细 JSON 结果。适用于邮件营销、用户注册验证、数据清洗及反欺诈场景，支持代理以实现大规模处理，采用双许可模式。
repos.summary_en: reacherhq/check-if-email-exists is a high-performance Rust open-source tool to verify email address existence and deliverability without sending any emails. It provides a popular Dockerized HTTP backend, CLI tool, and Rust library for integration. Key features include syntax validation, MX record checks, SMTP probing, detection of disposable emails, role accounts, catch-all addresses, and more, with detailed JSON output on reachability. Ideal for email marketing, user onboarding, data cleaning, and fraud prevention. Supports proxies for scale and uses dual licensing.

repos.summary_zh: Mailflare 是基于 Cloudflare 的自托管专业邮件收件箱，支持自定义域名。通过 Cloudflare Email Routing 与 Workers 实现收发邮件、附件、共享邮箱、路由规则、实时通知等完整功能。数据存于用户自有 D1 与 R2，可一键部署或 Docker 自建，适合个人与团队低成本掌控企业邮箱。
repos.summary_en: Mailflare is a self-hosted professional email inbox for custom domains built on Cloudflare. It leverages Email Routing and Workers for full-featured send/receive with attachments, shared mailboxes, routing rules, real-time notifications and more. Data stays in your own D1 and R2. One-click deploy or Docker self-host, ideal for individuals and teams seeking low-cost control of business email.

repos.description: 极简 Cloudflare Worker，接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取
repos.summary_zh: ni-mail 是一个极简 Cloudflare Worker，通过 Email Routing 接收私人域名邮件并提供 HTTP API 读取。使用 KV 存储最多 50 封邮件，postal-mime 解析为结构化 JSON，支持 API Key 鉴权和多自定义域名，附件仅存 metadata。无需数据库、前端或 JWT，部署简单，适合自动化脚本获取邮件内容，实现轻量级邮件集成。
repos.summary_en: ni-mail is a minimalist Cloudflare Worker that receives private domain emails via Cloudflare Email Routing and exposes them through a simple HTTP API. It stores up to 50 emails in KV, parses them with postal-mime into structured JSON, supports API key auth and multiple custom domains, and keeps only attachment metadata. No database, frontend or JWT needed; ideal for automation scripts fetching emails in a lightweight, serverless setup.
